lines.1: There were still students out on the school grounds.
lines.2: Even this late, quite a few people were hanging around.
lines.3: The Sports and Martial Arts Festival was probably why.
lines.4: Sato and I walked side by side.
lines.5: I got embarrassed whenever other people saw us.
lines.6: We had walked home together before, but for some reason it felt incredibly embarrassing now.
lines.7: 「Tsushima, you hang out with Date and the others at night too, right?」
lines.8: Sato was the one who broke the silence.
lines.10: 「I'm jealous of that kind of thing.」
lines.11: 「I'm an only child, and now I'm living here on my own after moving in from out of town, right?」
lines.12: 「I guess I've always admired that sort of thing.」
lines.14: 「Ahaha. I saw you and Date working together so happily today, and it got me thinking.」
lines.15: 「It must be nice to be that close, spending time together day and night.」
lines.16: 「You've got the Princess... Erika Kiriya, don't you?」
lines.18: 「Ellie is always busy with work and everything.」
lines.20: Being a candidate to take over Kiriya Company couldn't be easy.
lines.21: 「If you'd like, come visit my place sometime.」
lines.23: 「Crab might end up moving in, though.」
lines.24: 「Ahaha... You don't have to bring everyone. You can come by yourself, Tsushima.」
lines.27: 「Wait, come to think of it, where do you live?」
lines.28: 「Keep walking this way to the national highway. I'm in apartment 602 of Reions Mansion.」
lines.29: 「Oh, by the entrance to Dobuzaka? So that's where you live.」
lines.30: 「You know the place? Guess you really are a local.」
lines.32: 「Um... if you want... want to come over now? No one else is there, so it'd just be the two of us. You can relax.」
lines.33: 「Ah, sorry. Today I'm doing a taste-testing job at the place where Crab works. They've got a new curry.」
lines.41: 「Tsushima, that career-path survey... Did you write anything down?」
lines.42: 「Haha. I played it safe and put 'college.'」
lines.44: 「Ellie invited me to join Kiriya Company, though.」
lines.45: 「Really? It's notorious, but it's a top-class company known around the world. Sounds good, doesn't it?」
lines.47: 「But that alone wouldn't feel completely fulfilling... Maybe I mean emotionally.」
lines.51: 「So, as an only child, you mean something like a warm family with a kind husband, cute kids, maybe a dog?」
lines.52: 「...That does sound nice. Yeah, a really warm family.」
lines.53: 「Then first you need to find a kind husband.」
lines.54: 「I'd like someone as kind as you, Tsushima.」
lines.55: Sato smiled, looking me in the eye.
lines.56: Before I knew it, we had reached the fork where we split up.
lines.59: Sato kept waving until I could no longer see her.
lines.60: It felt like we had talked about a lot of personal things.
lines.61: And she had volunteered all of it without me even asking.
lines.62: My heart thudded deep in my chest.
lines.63: It left me with a bittersweet feeling.
lines.64: I wanted to talk to Sato again tomorrow.
lines.65: I want to be happy... huh.
lines.66: Wait. Does that mean she is not happy now?
lines.67: So because she is an only child living by herself, she is lonely, and that is why she is not happy?
lines.68: I can see how she has plenty to worry about, too.
lines.69: I wanted to make her happy.
